claim: A butt marked for Fino loses its flor without ever being refortified
because: A Palo Cortado loses its flor on its own rather than because it was refortified, but once the capataz sees this and marks the butt with the cut stick, the wine is normally refortified to about 17.5% so it can age oxidatively without spoiling. 'Without ever being refortified' is therefore false. The key (Palo Cortado) is still right.
fix: A butt marked for Fino loses its flor on its own, not because it was refortified, and finishes with the nose of an Amontillado over the body of an Oloroso. Which style is it?
